title: Partite matching code property
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers with $k>0$, and let $M$ be a perfect matching in the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. Encode $M$ by the matching code obtained from the canonical coding of perfect matchings on $2rk$ vertices. When this code is decoded on the ordered list $0,1,\ldots,2rk-1$, every paired pair of vertices has endpoints whose quotients upon division by $k$ are different.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a perfect matching in the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part
